channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump says Hamas, other armed groups in Gaza agree to disarm under US peace plan
item.description: President Trump says Hamas and other armed groups have agreed to fully disarm as part of his 20-point Gaza peace plan. What do you think this means for the future of the region?

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Court filing challenges use of Florida's 'Halo Law' in Riverview woman's arrest
item.description: An attorney for a Riverview woman arrested during a Hillsborough County traffic stop last year has asked a judge to dismiss all three misdemeanor charges against her.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Attorney for Nolan Wells' family says experts to review boat distress call
item.description: An attorney for the family of Nolan Wells said Thursday that they have hired audio engineers to review a distress call made from a boat on the day of his disappearance.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Missing Tennessee girl found with the help of Hillsborough County detectives, suspect arrested in Texas: HCSO
item.description: A 23-year-old man who is accused of abducting and sexually abusing a missing Tennessee girl whom he had traveled with to the Tampa Bay area was arrested July 29.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Deadline for 2 Pinellas County disaster relief programs is Friday
item.description: Pinellas County said the application deadline for its Homebuyer Assistance and Disaster Relief Reimbursement Program for Renters is July 31.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Volunteers speak out after 2 arrested for leaving mothballs on St. Pete Beach
item.description: Volunteers who picked up mothballs on St. Pete Beach back in April are now speaking out, after the people responsible for leaving the mothballs in the sand were caught.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] TSA in Alabama find stolen Civil War-era cannonballs in passenger's suitcase
item.description: A TSA agent discovered a set of stolen Civil War-era cannonballs in a passenger's suitcase during a routine security screening at an Alabama airport earlier this month, law enforcement officials said.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Hillsborough's Back 2 School Bash to give away thousands of free backpacks, supplies
item.description: Volunteers are assembly-lining thousands of free back-to-school backpacks at the Hillsborough County Fairgrounds to help local families prepare for the upcoming school year.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: city council] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa City Council seeks faster emergency response times in New Tampa
item.description: Tampa City Council members explored more ways to reduce emergency response times in New Tampa.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] St. Pete doctors see uptick in children ingesting hazardous household items: 'One pill can kill'
item.description: Doctors with Johns Hopkins All Children’s Hospital have seen an uptick in cases of kids accidentally swallowing and ingesting hazardous items around the house.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] State grant funds $330K for emergency support vehicle for Pinellas County first responders
item.description: Emergency crews across Pinellas County have a new tool to battle extreme heat and exhaustion while working high-stakes emergency calls.

item.description: Barbs are being traded in the race for St. Petersburg Mayor, with neither of the top two polling leaders expecting the race to be decided without going to a runoff.
